## System Goal

What user workflow or organizational problem does this system support?

## Users And Use Case

Who uses it, what do they need, and what counts as success?

## Architecture

Describe the major components: retrieval, tools, agents, model calls, storage, evaluation, monitoring, and deployment.

## Data And Context

Describe documents, images, structured data, metadata, prompts, and evaluation examples.

## Evaluation

Define quality metrics, automated evaluators, human review, and regression tests.

## Failure Modes

Discuss hallucination, missing context, retrieval errors, drift, latency, cost, unsafe tool use, and version regressions.

## Monitoring And LLMOps

Explain tracing, dashboards, alerting, prompt/model versioning, and release discipline.

## Deployment Recommendation

Translate the evidence into a launch, iterate, or hold recommendation.
